text:
mike_sales: Hey team — Acme Fintech is greenlighting a 4-week pilot (evaluation) that must integrate with their HSM/BYOK flow. They called out a few blockers from procurement/security: rotation window requirements, latency impact for per-request signing, egress/network allowlist, and a committed pricing option for a minimal dedicated footprint. Can eng/security weigh in? @raj_se @sylvie_sec

raj_se: Quick clarifying q — do they require synchronous per-request signing (no batching) or can we use a short batching window? Per-request will add ~20–80ms depending on proxy and session reuse.

mike_sales: They emphasized low-latency per-request signing, target 100 TPS bursts across two regions. Also want proof points for our latency numbers in their security questionnaire.

sylvie_sec: :thinking_face: Need to confirm HSM topology — CloudHSM vs customer-provided HSM behind a proxy. Also whether they want keys generated in-HSM or import (BYOK). Procurement will ask for FIPS/PIV attestation and our KMS audit log retention window. We should attach our attestation + SOC summary.

raj_se: For BYOK import we support key import via wrapped-blob using our KMS API. For latency, recommend dedicated pool + persistent sessions and TCP keepalives to avoid handshake on every request. Example config snippet we can share with them:

```yaml
service: redwood-dedicated
capacity: minimal-4-gpu
hsm_proxy: true
sessions: 80
batching: disabled
connection_pool: 100
```

raj_se: With that setup, measured median sign latency (including proxy hop) is ~28ms in our lab for 64-byte payloads; p95 ~70ms at sustained 100 tps. I can attach perf logs.

mike_sales: Pricing ask — they want a committed monthly quote for the minimal dedicated config + HSM ops and an option for a short-term pilot rate. @joe_solutions can you sketch a ballpark (commit vs pilot uplift)? Also they want SOW timing for exchange and onboarding.

joe_solutions: I’ll draft a stub: pilot (4 weeks) = pilot fee + usage at hosted rates; committed (monthly 3/6/12) discounts start at 20% for 3mo commit. HSM ops add a per-key monthly + per-signing-op fee for BYOK import scenarios. I need expected daily signing volume to refine.

mike_sales: They gave a rough: avg 30 TPS sustained, 100 TPS bursts, about 50k signs/day. Use that for now. Also procurement asked if emergency rotation is supported and how rollback works.

sylvie_sec: Emergency rotation supported. We provide rotation hooks in control plane + webhook notifications for key lifecycle events. Rollback depends on whether they imported keys or generated in HSM — for imported keys we can re-import previous wrapped key material if they hold escrow; for HSM-generated keys we can re-enable old version if not destroyed. Will add detail to the questionnaire response.

raj_se: Need their network team to allowlist our HSM proxy IPs and ensure TLS mutual auth for the proxy tunnel. Also confirm whether requests will be routed through a customer VPN or over public endpoints (impacts latency and egress billing).

mike_sales: Action items: Joe to draft pricing SOW + pilot fee; Raj to attach perf logs + sample harness for their perf tests; Sylvie to prepare security questionnaire answers and attestations; I'll schedule a sync with their engineering/procurement for Wed.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2345 for KMS pilot provisioning and added initial checklist (network allowlist, HSM model, key-import flow, perf harness).

mike_sales: Thanks — aiming to have a proposal and questionnaire responses by EOD Tuesday so procurement can review ahead of Wed.
